overview.en: This large rattlesnake ranges from southern Mexico through Central America to Costa Rica.
overview.fr: Ce grand crotale s’étend du sud du Mexique à l’Amérique centrale jusqu’au Costa Rica.

identification.en: Its robust body often bears dark diamond-shaped dorsal markings and a conspicuous rattle.
identification.fr: Son corps robuste porte souvent des marques dorsales en losanges sombres et un hochet bien visible.

habitat.en: It uses dry forests, thorn scrub, savannas and some open pine-oak landscapes, avoiding dense wet forest.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les forêts sèches, brousses épineuses, savanes et certains paysages ouverts de pins et chênes; il évite les forêts humides denses.

diet.en: It eats rodents and other small vertebrates, including lizards; prey records vary among local populations.
diet.fr: Il consomme des rongeurs et d’autres petits vertébrés, dont des lézards; les proies signalées varient selon les populations.

behavior.en: Adults are often crepuscular or nocturnal, sheltering beneath rocks, logs or in abandoned burrows by day.
behavior.fr: Les adultes sont souvent crépusculaires ou nocturnes et se cachent le jour sous les rochers, troncs ou dans d’anciens terriers.

reproduction.en: This rattlesnake is viviparous; reports describe mating in winter and births during the warmer season.
reproduction.fr: Ce crotale est vivipare; des observations rapportent des accouplements en hiver et des naissances pendant la saison chaude.

ecology.en: Older treatments grouped C. culminatus and C. tzabcan within C. simus; subsequent studies recognize them separately.
ecology.fr: D’anciennes classifications incluaient C. culminatus et C. tzabcan dans C. simus; des études ultérieures les reconnaissent séparément.

conservation.en: Habitat conversion and deliberate killing are documented pressures, particularly where snakes enter farms and settlements.
conservation.fr: La transformation des habitats et les destructions volontaires sont des pressions documentées, notamment près des cultures et villages.

uncertainties: Taxonomic boundaries within the former Crotalus durissus complex have changed, so older range and status summaries may combine species.
review_note: Compared the Mexican Redtox species profile and CONANP habitat account with peer-reviewed revisions of the C. durissus complex; avoided transferring old combined-species ranges wholesale.

facts: Redtox summarizes appearance, prey, activity, reproduction and human pressures.
